''See also: [[Dead Mother Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Dead Mother, also known as [[Nakothi]], is a fallen Elder whose massive corpse forms the basis of a strange and vast island in the [[Aion Sea]]. Her death was caused by being defeated by the Emperor and the [[Estyr Six]], an event involving death throes so violent they shattered the surrounding land. Even in death, her influence remains immense; her body continues to heave and break mountains, and her limbs are large enough to blot out the sun. Her presence is characterized by a cold, blazing power and an eternal whispering voice that attempts to manipulate humans into dying so she may reshape them into monstrous forms. [[Nakothi]]'s power manifests through several entities and objects. She possesses multiple hearts, which are highly sought after for their ability to provide hidden knowledge of life and death or to potentially resurrect her. Her influence also creates the [[Children of the Dead Mother]]—horrific, specialized beings fashioned from human remains and infused with her power. These creatures, along with various undead, serve as her armies. Additionally, certain weapons can be imbued with her essence, and individuals may become subject to her [[Authority|authority]] or even serve as her puppets. While some have made bargains to use her power, there is a constant risk that she will eventually rise and exert total control over those connected to her.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Dead Mother is a gargantuan, walking corpse. Her massive body actually forms the island of [[Nakothi]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|This entity exerts a magnetic influence that draws people toward it and possesses an eternal whispering voice. She attempts to convince humans to die so she can remake them into monstrosities.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Dead Mother is connected to the Emperor, whose life and body are at risk due to her influence. [[Kelarac]] is able to utilize the power she possesses, while [[Syphren]] has stabbed her heart. [[Shera]] focuses on this entity and seeks to remove it from her life.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|She is a power capable of destroying, stitching together, and remaking bodies. Additionally, she can create spawn and servants, and her presence increases the strength of her [[Children]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Influence and the Heart}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The influence of the Dead Mother expanded until it ultimately resulted in the death of the Emperor.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 20</ref> This power possesses the ability to remake bodies, and its signature is reflected in the thoughts associated with the Heart.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 23</ref> The [[Heart of Nakothi]] was once pried from the body of the Dead Mother, a being that also possesses spawn.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c25">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 25</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]]'s influence grew to the point that the Emperor was killed.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The thoughts associated with the Heart have a signature similar to the [[Dead Mother]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is a power that can remake bodies.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Heart of Nakothi]] was pried out of the [[Dead Mother]]'s body.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] has spawn.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Dead Mother was once a being possessing many hearts, including eleven others.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c20">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 20</ref> This gargantuan entity is so massive that its body constitutes the island of [[Nakothi]], and it exerts a power that draws people toward it.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c10">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 13</ref> While a prisoner once swore by her, the entity's influence is felt through [[Shera]]'s blade, though [[Shera]] desires to remove her from her life.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c11">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 11</ref> The release of the Heart's power has the potential to wake her, and her voice is closely associated with that same power.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 17</ref> Though her cults were previously exterminated by the [[Luminian|Luminians]], her eternal whispering voice attempts to convince humans to die so she can destroy and rebuild their bodies into monstrosities.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c16">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 19</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] once had many hearts.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The prisoner swore by [[Dead Mother]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is a gargantuan entity whose body forms [[Nakothi's island]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Shera]]'s blade reminds her of the [[Dead Mother]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Shera]] wants to clear the [[Dead Mother]] out of her life.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is a power that draws people toward it.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] could be woken by the release of the Heart's power.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] had cults that were exterminated by the [[Luminian|Luminians]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]]'s voice is associated with the Heart.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]]'s voice whispers eternally and tries to convince humans to die so she can remake them into a monstrosity.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] destroys bodies and builds them anew.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] once had eleven other hearts.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c20" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Sleeping Entity}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Dead Mother is currently in a state of sleep.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c24">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 24</ref> A scream was heard from the entity out on the [[Aion]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c25">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 25</ref> There is a belief that someone is being corrupted by the Dead Mother.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c27">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 27</ref>}}

<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] screamed from out on the [[Aion]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Someone believes they are being corrupted by the [[Dead Mother]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c27" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Threat to the Emperor}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Dead Mother holds a specific power that [[Kelarac]] is capable of utilizing.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c22">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 22</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">1</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] possesses power that [[Kelarac]] could use.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c22" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|After [[Syphren]] stabbed the [[Dead Mother's heart]], she remained a potential threat for which the Emperor has developed a contingency plan.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 3</ref> Known as [[Nakothi]], this being is capable of creating servants and would achieve victory if the human's soul were to die.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 9</ref> The Dead Mother is a potential entity that could take over the Emperor, posing a risk that he might hand over his body to her.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c12">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c20">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 20</ref> If [[Heart of Nakothi|Nakothi's Heart]] is not separated from the Emperor, her power can bring him back to life.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c14">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 14</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Syphren]] has stabbed the [[Dead Mother's heart]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is a potential threat that the Emperor has a contingency plan for.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is a figure whose victory would occur if the human's soul died.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is a being capable of creating servants.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is [[Nakothi]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is a potential entity that could take over the Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]]'s power can bring the Emperor back to life if [[Heart of Nakothi|Nakothi's Heart]] is not separated from him.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Emperor risks handing over his body to the [[Dead Mother]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is something a person can smell like.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Walking Corpse}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Dead Mother is a giant walking corpse that possesses the potential to stitch someone back together.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> This entity's proximity grants increased power to her [[Children]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref> She is a being that [[Shera]] focuses on.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is an entity that could potentially stitch someone back together.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is a giant corpse walking.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]]'s proximity makes her [[Children]] more powerful.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Dead Mother|The Dead Mother]] is a being [[Shera]] focuses on.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“As I believe the Emperor taught you, the Dead Mother once had many hearts.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“I’m not even sure what that would mean,” Shera said, ignoring the Dead Mother’s voice.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“He thinks he’s being corrupted by the Dead Mother.”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c27" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“It’s only a precaution, in case the Dead Mother takes over. We’re his…contingency plan.”<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3" />}}
